video_title: Bye Bye Pergola, Hello Covered Patio | Backyard Remodel Before & After | The Gathering Place
assessment: An old pergola, a rickety deck and a stamped slab that settled and cracked, replaced by a roofed patio cover tied into the house, six stucco columns on sonotube footings, new stamped concrete, a TimberTech deck, can lights, coach lights, ceiling fans, outlets at the top of the columns for electric blinds, a gas line to a quick connect for the barbecue and a stub for a future hot tub. The existing Short already covers the footings and the concrete, so this one is the finished party patio. Burned in green subtitles run through much of the finished footage, so every scene is picked from a clean window.
